articles.headline: Shashi Tripathi, IIT Summit Chairman: Fortt Knox Innovation Lab
articles.summary: IIT Global conference organizer Shashi Tripathi told Jon Fortt that AI should be treated as an extension of human capability, not a replacement — graduates who do so will outcompete peers. Many young IITians, he said, are bypassing shrinking coding jobs to start companies. Meanwhile, India is racing to catch up on AI: the recent India AI Mission drew 250,000 attendees, and the country's 27 languages and cultural variety could feed richer LLM training data.

articles.summary: Tesla began rolling out xAI's Grok AI chatbot in its cars in July 2025, which is still in beta mode. Tesla is not the only automaker adding AI assistants to vehicles.
